system.description:
Shortens how long an effect persists. Source: Multiverse.
Level 0: Remains in effect Attribute description indicates (which is usually one minute or dramatic scene)
Level 1: Remains in effect for 30 seconds (or only part of a dramatic scene)
Level 2: Remains in effect for 5 rounds
Level 3: Remains in effect for 2 rounds
Level 4: Remains in effect for 1 round
Level 5: Remains in effect for 1-2 seconds
Level 6: The effect is instantaneous or has no significant duration
